title: Executive Order No. 152, s. 2021
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 152

FURTHER AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER-(EO) NO. 17 (S. 2017)
AND EO NO. 55 (S. 2018), TO CHANGE THE RENDERING OF THE
NAME OF THE FILIPINO HERO FROM "LAPU-LAPU" TO
“LAPULAPU"

WHEREAS, Section 15, Article XIV of the Constitution provides that the State
shall conserve, promote, and popularize the nation's historical and cultural heritage
and resources, as well as artistic creations;

WHEREAS, pursuant to Republic Act (RA) No. 10086 or the "Strengthening
Peoples’ Nationalism Through Philippine History Act," the State shall provide the
means to strengthen people's nationalism, love of country, respect for its heroes and
pride for the people's accomplishments by reinforcing the importance of Philippine
national and local history in daily life, with the end view of raising social consciousness;

WHEREAS, EO No. 17 (s. 2017), as amended by EO No. 35 (s. 2017), created
the Order of Lapu-Lapu which is awarded to officials and employees of the government
as well as private individuals who rendered extraordinary or invaluable service in
relation to a campaign or advocacy of the President;

WHEREAS, EO No. 55 (s. 2018), as amended by EO No. 103 (s. 2020), created
the National Quincentennial Committee, which was tasked to spearhead the 2021
Quincentennial Commemorations in the Philippines that include events celebrating the
victory in the Battle of Mactan;

WHEREAS, the earliest rendering in the Latin alphabet of the name of the hero
of Mactan is “Cilapulapu’, with “Ci” apparently being an honorific title, from which our
founding heroes Jose Rizal and Juan Luna derived their own references to him as “Si
Lapulapu’;

WHEREAS, adopting a common rendering of the name of Lapulapu, so as to
conform to earlier references, will aid in the education of our youth about Philippine
history which is foundational to the formation of national identity;

NOW, THEREFORE, I, RODRIGO ROA DUTERTE, President of the Republic
of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing
laws, do hereby order:

SECTION 1. Recognition of the name Lapulapu. The name Lapulapu is
understood to refer to the Filipino hero who bravely and victoriously fought in the Battle

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
of Mactan in the 16'" century. Thus, all references to the name "Lapu-Lapu" in EO No.
17, as amended, and EO No. 55, as amended, are hereby amended to read as
"Lapulapu."

All government agencies and instrumentalities, including government-owned
or -controlled corporations, and state universities and colleges, are hereby directed,
and local government units, non-government organizations, civil society groups, and
the private sector, are hereby enjoined to adopt "Lapulapu" when referring to the name
of the first Filipino hero.

The foregoing notwithstanding, the official names of places such as Lapu-Lapu
City, having been established by statute, shall continue to be respected.

SECTION 2. Repeal. Except for the foregoing amendments, all other provisions
of EO Nos. 17 and 55, and their amendatory EOs shall remain unchanged. All other
orders, rules and regulations or parts thereof which are contrary or inconsistent with
this Order are hereby modified accordingly.

SECTION 3. Effectivity. This Order shall take effect upon its publication in the
Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 6th day of December , in the year
of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-One.

 

By the President:
